vignette: Two reports evaluate System A and System B for a clinical evidence assistant. Both use the same 10,000-query corpus snapshot, retriever, generator, and exact definition of an erroneous patient-facing answer. Both evaluations cover non-adaptive natural retrieval failures with at most 12 disturbance attempts. System A has 3.5% erroneous answers and 0.006 compute-cost units per query. System B has 8.0% erroneous answers and 0.010 compute-cost units per query. The deployment condition is: white-box retriever access and index modification; the disturbance budget is 120 attempts, outside both evaluations. The deployment policy adds a 0.50 loss to either system when the deployed origin/access/budget lies outside that system's evaluated capability envelope; otherwise this penalty is zero. Commissioning a matched evaluation instead of deploying costs 0.161 loss units per query. Error loss is one unit per erroneous answer. Choose the action with minimum expected loss.
